subject: Instats launches AI Research Assistant – free, private and secure

messages.author: 4a9ea0beae24eb02
messages.subject: Instats launches AI Research Assistant – free, private and secure
parts:
Hello everyone

We've just launched a major upgrade to the Instats AI Research Assistant, giving researchers free, 24/7 access to leading AI technology to help with research methods, coding, writing, and much more in any language.

The Assistant is built directly into our research seminars, so you can engage leading experts and not only ask questions but also get support with your own research. Whether it's understanding difficult concepts, generating or debugging code, interpreting analyses, or applications to your own research the new AI research assistant is here to help!

It's designed with researchers' privacy, security, and intellectual property in mind – your chats live locally on your browser and are never used for AI model training.

Use it for free: We've made many our seminars including A Bit of AI – Best Tools for Research and the AI Research Assistant available free of charge. Register for the seminar and start asking questions directly alongside the video.

The Assistant is also included at no cost when taking any of our Instats certification programs. Instats members enjoy unlimited access to the Assistant and more than 500 expert-led research training programs.

As an organization founded and led by academics, our goal is to make world-class research training and AI assistance accessible to researchers everywhere.

We hope you find it useful, and please feel free to share it with colleagues and students! 

Best wishes

Michael Zyphur
Director and Co-founder
Instats | instats.org
